name: ngrok Tunnel
author: hearth-team
description: Public HTTPS ingress for inbound webhooks (Apify callbacks, Twilio SMS, Retell voice, GitHub, Stripe). Supervisor spawns ngrok as a child process at boot, captures the public URL, and exposes it to other skills via INGRESS_PUBLIC_URL. HMAC-signed inbound only — no anonymous traffic.

family.name: Ingress Family
family.description: Public-internet ingress providers. Pick one (ngrok / Tailscale Funnel / hosted Hearth) — webhook skills auto-discover via INGRESS_PUBLIC_URL.

vault_inputs.label: ngrok Authtoken
vault_inputs.help: From dashboard.ngrok.com → Your Authtoken. Free-tier accounts work. Encrypted in vault.

vault_inputs.label: Static domain (optional, strongly recommended)
vault_inputs.help: Claim a free static domain at dashboard.ngrok.com → Domains → New Domain. Without one, the URL changes every restart and webhook subscriptions break.

vault_inputs.label: Webhook HMAC secret
vault_inputs.help: Required token in the X-Hearth-Token header on every inbound webhook. Generate a random one (32+ chars). Hearth rejects requests missing or mismatching this.

settings.label: Tunnel target port
settings.help: Supervisor port that ngrok forwards traffic to. 3417 is the Hearth default — only change if you've remapped.

verbs.description: Returns current tunnel state: { running, public_url, started_at, error }.
Stops + restarts the tunnel process. Use after rotating the authtoken or changing the static domain.
